summary: APM feed c010_broker is dropping 50.37% of packets at packet broker egress VF-1 1/5 due to sustained 10 Gbps saturation (bursts higher). Link is otherwise healthy. APM is missing half of transactions.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker egress port VF-1 1/5 to APM is oversubscribed: average load is 100% of 10 Gbps and bursts exceed line rate, so the broker is tail-dropping ~190M packets (50.37%) on output before delivery to tool.
findings.impact_on_tool: APM receives only ~49.6% of traffic. With needs_both_directions=true, missing packets break request/response pairing, causing incomplete transactions, inaccurate latency/error rates, and missed performance degradations/false negatives.

recommended_fix.why: Distributing flows across 2-3x 10G APM ports (or upgrading to 25/40G) keeps per-port utilization <60-70% even during bursts and preserves bidirectional flow symmetry required by APM, eliminating the 50% broker discards without filtering needed traffic. Alternative is tool_capacity upgrade or filtering to only APM-relevant traffic if load balancing not possible.
